Bihar’s Amas–Darbhanga Expressway is set to become a transformative Triple Airport Link, connecting the wider regions of Patna, Gaya, and Darbhanga through one high-speed corridor. Designed as Bihar’s first access-controlled greenfield expressway, it will ease the long, congested journey between South and North Bihar, improve airport access, and strengthen the movement of people and goods across the state. MEIL is executing three major stretches, making a significant contribution to one of Bihar’s most important infrastructure projects.
